replaces: the plain seeded draw of 150 from the 300 (8 Oct 2026; in git history), which held 16 adders and touched 63 of 119 outside categories
pool: all 1008 new checked kinds (the 500 new kinds in use plus the 508 leftovers that passed the same repeat check); the original 32 are left out because the September designs used them

excluded.why: the same job (a + b) with a different speed trick, or a trivial piece, holding no state; our designs are about relations between stored values

categories_from: kind_categories_2026-10-09.json (category = the primary area both judges chose)
rule: catalog_kinds.even_draw(usable, 150, seed): one kind from every category, then a second from categories that still have one, categories and kinds in a seeded random order
split: catalog_kinds.balanced_split(the 150, family, seed): a category with two kinds puts one in each half; categories with one kind are dealt to the halves in turn, family by family, so every family differs by at most one. First half -> constructs_150_even_2026-10-09_twostep.txt (idea, then design); second -> constructs_150_even_2026-10-09_onestep.txt (design directly, with self-repair). Replaces alternating down the draw order, which put 17 arithmetic kinds in one half and 4 in the other (checked 9 Oct 2026, before any design was made).
